title: Kojima et al. 2024 (Dataset B) — Four-class ASME BCI: investigation of the feasibility and comparison of two strategies for multiclassing
description: EEG dataset from 15 healthy participants performing a four-class auditory stream segregation multiclass ERP (ASME) brain-computer interface task. Two strategies for reaching four classes were compared: ASME-4stream (four streams, one target stimulus each) and ASME-2stream (two streams, two target stimuli each). The recordings support analysis of P300 responses, binary classification, and offline BCI simulation with linear discriminant analysis.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG plus horizontal and vertical EOG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a BrainAmp amplifier and EasyCap passive Ag/AgCl electrodes, referenced to the right mastoid. Each participant completed 12 runs alternating between ASME-4stream (SOA 0.15 s) and ASME-2stream (SOA 0.3 s), with 4 trials per run of about 90 s each. Participants selectively attended to deviant stimuli in one stream and counted them. Workload was assessed with the NASA-TLX questionnaire.
